subject: ADR-213: the one artefact this page tells a student to save carried the data, the hypotheses, and none of the answers
body: ADR-211 measured 32 figures the ecology lab works out that nothing it hands over carries, and deferred them with a reason: the lab's only export is a .eco PROTOCOL, the lines you would RUN, and by design it carries inputs and hypotheses rather than results. That reason was right about what an .eco file IS and wrong about what follows from it -- a reader handed the protocol had every input and no way to tell whether their answer matched the one on the screen. WHERE THE NUMBERS WERE: five workbench readouts -- field diversity, two-site beta diversity, quadrat dispersion, mark-recapture, Hardy-Weinberg -- each worked out its arithmetic inside its own render function and assigned it straight into innerHTML, so there was no VALUE anywhere and nothing else could read it. The exporter rebuilt the DATA lines from the same boxes and stopped, because the only way to get the answers would have been to do the arithmetic a second time, and a second copy of a calculation is a second source of truth (ADR-068) that agrees with the first only until one of them is edited. ONE COMPUTATION, TWO READERS: each is extracted to a stat* function returning numbers and returning null on exactly the condition its panel prints a refusal for; the panel renders from it, the exporter reads it, and nothing is re-derived in the exporter. verify_eco reads the figures off the PANEL and requires each in the protocol text as the same digits -- and found the first disagreement immediately: the panel writes a 95% CI with an EN DASH and the exporter had a hyphen. RESULTS AS COMMENTS, AND THAT IS THE POINT: a .eco file is a pre-registration and this page's own instruction is 'edit BEFORE you run; that's the discipline', so a result written as a protocol line would make the file assert what it is supposed to be asking; as comments they are provenance -- legal .eco, ignored by the engine, and they let anyone re-running the protocol see whether they landed where the workbench landed. The block is absent when there is nothing to report. WHAT REMAINS is the nine stations, rendered from a session JSON by nine independent renderers; a run record is not a pre-registration. 32 TO 19, and the ceiling is 19.
